name: ViewIcons
description: Makes avatars and banners in user profiles clickable, adds View Icon/Banner/Avatar entries in the user, server and group channel context menu.
summary: Click avatars and banners to open them full size; "View Icon/Banner/Avatar" menu items

settings.label: Format
settings.description: Choose the image format to use for non-animated images. Animated images will always use .webp

gaps: View Avatar Decoration: Qord does not read avatar decorations yet.
Clickable icons in a DM's or group DM's header: Qord's channel header shows no icon.
View Icon for group DMs without a custom icon: upstream opens Discord's built-in default group icon, which Qord does not have.
notes: Images open in Qord's image viewer (zoom, pan, Esc to close). Upstream's modal also links the 4096px original; the viewer loads the chosen size.
